input.quote: the parties agree that the validity, interpretation and legal effect of this Agreement shall be governed by the internal laws of the State of New York, U.S.A.
input.rationale: Article XXIV(a) selects New York internal law, and the following paragraph requires any suit arising out of or relating to the Agreement to be instituted in the City of New York with irrevocable submission to the exclusive jurisdiction of the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York or any New York State court, plus a venue/forum non conveniens waiver. There is no arbitration provision anywhere in the document and no competing foreign forum. This meets our preferred position (New York law; exclusive New York state and federal courts). Two immaterial points noted only: venue is expressed as the "City of New York" rather than "New York County," and there is no express carve-out for temporary injunctive relief elsewhere — neither is worth a redline. The mutual forum non conveniens waiver in p0146 binds both parties equally and is acceptable.
